area: the UI theme (UIThemeLive, ColorSetUITheme) and its tests
summary: The worn colour set now paints every UI colour, not only the 13 tokens: UIThemeLive retraces non-token colours through ColorTrace (graphics, TMP gradients, ColorTint ColorBlocks, Shadow/Outline, input carets), sweeps changed root canvases every frame instead of once a second, and swaps the tooltip and element tokens too; ColorSetUITheme.Build reads ui-token ids from the set, so the element colours and tooltip are each set's own (Photic keeps the authored values). ColorSetUIThemeTests.TheElementColours_StayAuthored became TheElementColours_AreTheSetsOwn_AndPhoticsAreTheAuthored.
why: Garrett, 2026-11-10: every colour in the game must respect the colour set, the UI included. Docs/VesselModels/COLOR_TRACE.md. Open decision for you both: under Photic the UI theme still re-hues the tokens (your 2026-11-09 console parity), so Photic's UI is not the authored UITheme.asset.
